claim_boundary: This run may authorize seed expansion but is not a sealed final test.

split_contract.sealed_test_policy: Do not generate, inspect, or tune on the reserved test layouts before the development gate passes.

allowed_model_inputs: neutral current DINO feature at query

model.pfc: one-layer causal window Transformer plus persistent history state
model.ec: frozen action-only egocentric SE(2) neural scaffold with periodic heading embedding
model.hpc: one episode-local differentiable fast-weight matrix with factorized place/context dual-key covariance correction and frozen identity value codec

optimization.primary_loss: two-way contrastive correct-content versus other-context content on conflict queries
optimization.secondary_loss: 1.0 weighted cosine error on clean queries
optimization.checkpoint_selection: development route and assignment families only

development_amendments.change: Freeze the HPC value encoder/decoder at identity and set direct PFC output gain to zero.
development_amendments.reason: The first development run exposed a value-codec/direct-output shortcut that passed pairwise accuracy but failed orthogonal-context intervention.

development_amendments.change: Use conflict accuracy, then clean cosine, then context re-entry as deterministic checkpoint tie-breaks; use the first context-entry state as the history intervention anchor.
development_amendments.reason: The original selector retained an early conflict-tied checkpoint with poor clean recall, and the original per-place intervention did not represent a context-level history anchor.

development_amendments.change: Reduce the development stability run from 600 to 100 steps.
development_amendments.reason: After shortcut removal, the frozen single-seed learning curve reached all gates by step 100; sealed test data remains unopened.

development_amendments.change: Freeze the randomly initialized periodic EC/grid/place scaffold during the content-memory task.
development_amendments.reason: The second development seed learned context re-entry but content gradients distorted the spatial address basis, lowering clean recall and the context oracle; all untrained spatial scaffolds achieved near-exact oracle recall.

development_amendments.change: Raise the clean-query cosine term from 0.25 to 1.0 without adding a new objective or supervision source.
development_amendments.reason: With the spatial scaffold frozen, one stability seed solved conflict/context but the underweighted clean term drifted below its pre-registered gate.

stop_rule: Any failed task gate stops training. Any failed model gate stops seed expansion and triggers targeted diagnosis.
expansion_rule: Only an all-green single-seed run may expand to three seeds.
